newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Trading active. - USDA

Slaughter Steers - Load Choice predominantly 3, Blacks 1302 lbs 69.25. High Select and Choice 2-3, 1200-1350 lbs 68.00-69.00. Select and Choice 2-3, 1100-1300 lbs 67.00-68.00. Select 1-2, 65.00-67.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Part Load Choice 2-3, long haul near 1250 lbs 69.25. High Select and Choice 2-3, 1050-1250 lbs 67.00-68.00. Select and Choice 2-3, 950-1100 lbs 64.50-67.00. Select 1-2, 63.50-64.50.
